system.reason: CLI application benefits from independent read, transformation and write boundaries.

children.name: File Reader
children.rationale: One boundary owns input decoding and read error reporting
risks: Malformed UTF-8 may cause read errors

children.name: Text Transformation
children.rationale: Separate transformation keeps parsing concerns distinct

children.name: File Writer
children.responsibility: Write output while preserving source on failure
children.rationale: Safe output handling is a distinct reliability concern

open_questions: Should the output replace an existing destination atomically?

read.reason: Read module is sufficient for a first architectural review

transform.reason: Pure transformation requires no further module decomposition

write.reason: Write boundary needs interface and failure-mode review, not more hierarchy
